name: flame_sdk_ios_tk_sigmob_adapter
summary: Flame iOS SDK TK Sigmob adapter without SigmobAd-iOS dependency.
description: A Flame iOS SDK private TK Sigmob adapter podspec wrapper. It uses TopOn's AnyThinkSigmobAdapter.xcframework and does not depend on SigmobAd-iOS. WindSDK and WindFoundation are provided by ToBid-iOS-RC to avoid duplicate frameworks in single-binary dual-core integration.
